verses.text: For the music director. By David, the LORD’s servant. This is what I’ve come to understand about the rebellion of the wicked: they live with no fear of God.
They think too highly of themselves to see their own sin and hate it.
Their words are full of evil and deceit. They’ve stopped acting wisely or doing good.
They lie in bed plotting wrong. They set out on a path that leads to no good and refuse to reject evil.
LORD, your faithful love reaches to the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like the depths of the sea. LORD, you keep people and animals alive.
How precious is your faithful love, God! People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
They feast on the abundance of your house. You let them drink from your river of delights.
The spring of life is with you. In your light we see light.
Keep showing faithful love to those who know you and righteousness to those whose hearts are upright.
Don’t let the proud trample me or the wicked drive me away.
Look, those who do evil have fallen. They’re knocked down and can’t rise.
